$comment: Gate thresholds for the v5 load harness. CI fails the build when a run
exceeds these. Baselines are captured by P0.3 before any v5 work lands;
M1 is not a threshold but an equivalence test — see stats.equivalent().
Its margin lives here so it can be tightened as the runtime improves

M1_frameEquivalence.$comment: Effective margin is max(marginMs, idle_p95 * marginRatio), so a fast baseline does not make the gate unreachable.

$M3_comment: The percentile gate uses the highest statistic the sample supports (p99 needs n>=1000, p95 needs n>=200); a typing probe realistically yields low hundreds, so p95 is the usual gate. M3_interactionMaxMs is an absolute ceiling gated independently, because an under-sampled percentile cannot see one catastrophic interaction.

validity.$comment: A run whose second half drifts more than 12% from its first half is discarded, not reported. See DEVNOTES_PERF_LOOP on this machine's fanless swings.

baselines.$comment: Filled by P0.3 against v4. Null means not yet captured.
